name: Your Place In The World
label: Quest
description: Your Place In The World: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Finally, you are of age, friend... Of age to battle in the name of the Horde. To conquer for the glory of the Warchief.
No doubt you wish to find a great dragon or demon and strangle it with your bare hands, but perhaps it would be wise to start on something less... Dangerous.
Report to Gornek, he should be able to assign a task better suited to a young adventurer. You will find Gornek in the Den, to the west.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Another one of Kaltunk's recruits, hm?
A sorry state of affairs we find ourselves in if this is the best the Horde can produce. No matter. By the time we think you're ready to leave the Valley, you'll be a proud warrior of the Horde.
